coverage.notes: The live official undergraduate catalogue advertises four routes (three degree titles; teacher-training has distinct in-person and blended application/delivery routes), and the institution supplies an explicit IB-admissions policy via the IB recognition directory. However the catalogue markets bilingual rather than wholly English-delivered study; English use increases by semester for both Letras degrees, and the teaching language of the English-to-Portuguese translation technologist is not specified. No 2027-specific catalogue or intake notice was found. These four records are researched potential first-degree routes, NOT a confirmed eligible English-taught 2027 set. The institution website prominently references the second-semester 2026 selection process. No qualification-, citizenship- or residency-specific 2027 fee list was identified. No graduate or short extension offerings are included.

institution.summary: Brazilian higher-education college specialising in bilingual English-teacher education and translation degrees.

programmes.name: Licenciatura em Letras - Inglês
programmes.campus: Presencial (on-campus location not stated on the course listing)
programmes.language: Bilingual; use of English in teaching increases across semesters; Portuguese share not specified
programmes.about: Four-year English-language teacher education for work in language courses and bilingual schools.
programmes.overview: This teacher-qualification degree prepares graduates to teach English in language programmes and bilingual schools. Academic study is combined with pedagogical practice and progressive development of English proficiency. The college describes its undergraduate teaching as bilingual, with English used more extensively in later semesters. Its wider course information also describes applied projects and opportunities for teaching placements within Cultura Inglesa centres.

programmes.name: Licenciatura em Letras - Inglês
programmes.language: Bilingual; use of English in teaching increases across semesters; Portuguese share not specified
programmes.about: Blended four-year route to the English-teaching licenciatura, with a published workload of 3,240 hours.
programmes.overview: This blended version leads to the same type of English-language teaching qualification as the in-person route. It is intended for future teachers in language courses and bilingual schools, combining English development with educational preparation. The college describes applied projects and practical teaching opportunities as part of its approach. The current course listing gives 3,240 hours over eight semesters, but does not specify the exact balance of in-person and remote teaching.

programmes.name: Bacharelado em Letras - Inglês e Tradução
programmes.campus: Presencial (on-campus location not stated on the course listing)
programmes.language: Bilingual; use of English in teaching increases across semesters; Portuguese share not specified
programmes.about: Four-year language and translation degree focused on translation, text editing, review and writing.
programmes.overview: This undergraduate degree develops language and translation capabilities for work with different kinds of texts. The institution highlights translation, revision and written production, supported by a bilingual curriculum that increases the use of English as study progresses. Its wider undergraduate information describes practical projects and potential placements at translation offices. The course is advertised in morning and evening in-person formats; a detailed current module list is not provided.

programmes.name: Tecnólogo Tradutor - Inglês
programmes.credential: Curso Superior de Tecnologia / Tecnólogo (undergraduate technology degree)
programmes.language: Teaching language not stated; course focuses on English-to-Portuguese written translation
programmes.about: Two-year online higher-education technology course in translation and text revision involving English and Portuguese.
programmes.overview: This technology degree is designed as a shorter undergraduate route for work in translation and text revision. Its stated emphasis is translation from English into Portuguese and the development of written English competence. The institution advertises 2,000 hours over four semesters in an online format, with synchronous sessions described as optional on the accessible catalogue. The language used to teach non-language subjects is not published, so the course is not verified as English-taught.

claims.statement: Faculdade Cultura Inglesa is the institution in the assigned official links. It offers higher-education courses focused on English teaching, bilingual education and translation. The undergraduate course catalogue is the appropriate official programme handoff.
